preconditions.description: The integer n is the length of the string s and satisfies 2 ≤ n ≤ 300,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s consists only of lowercase Latin letters.
The string s has exactly n characters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' or (stdout.startswith('YES') and len(stdout.split()) == 3 and all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdout.split()[1:]))
postconditions.description: If no valid substring exists to reverse for a lexicographically smaller string, output 'NO'. Otherwise, output 'YES' followed by two integers l and r (1 ≤ l < r ≤ n) representing the substring to reverse.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' or (stdout.startswith('YES') and (s[:l-1] + s[l-1:r][::-1] + s[r:]) < s)
postconditions.description: If 'YES' is printed, the substring s[l-1:r] (0-based) when reversed must produce a string lexicographically smaller than the original s.
